notes.title: 900 Books Total and Improved Lighting
notes.content:
[list]
[*] 175 books added for a total of 900
[*] Improved light volumetric compatibility
[*] Fixed floor illumination for Alephian Monastery on newer hardware
[*] Increased lustre for the Library
[*] Removed a lurking bug that could have turned certain levels pitch black
[*] Improved performance for Alien's Tailbone and retextured architecture
[/list]

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
-Added over 30 books including a non-fiction book, 'Tav Null: 'Below' the Empty Set'
-Fixed shadowing glitches for over 30 meshes on newer devices
-Improved illumination for Alephian Monastery and Stone Face
-Adjusted colouring for Shrine of the Glitch
-Fixed broken texture in Cantorian Monastery
-Minor fixes to Vectorian levels
-Added architecture to a developer-only level
-Removed development text from some places
-Adjusted saturation for intro card

notes.title: Major update: Shrine of the Glitch
notes.content:
The Shrine of the Glitch is here! You can access it from the Vectorian Monastery, following the green arrow and entering the green bell. Obtain a rare glitch entity item for your rune collection.

-New Vectorian Island
-Much-requested progress bar now available from Alephian Monastery 
-Glass materials have been modified to reduce ugly reflections
-Riemann Sphere north poles are now constantly illuminated
-Many Vectorian island improvements
-51 books have been added to the knowledgebase for a total of 90
-A library decoration has been modified to assist in a later puzzle
-Goldilocks towers are easier to navigate with bigger arrows
-More information in the Fractal Octopus shrine for connections between the infinite and the void
-Another attempt to fix shadowing issues for Alien's Tailbone

Shrine of the Glitch designed by Mark Cooper Art.
Enjoy!
